title: Cloud Engineer
description:
Job Title:- Azure Cloud Engineer

Location:- Remote (Brazil)


The Senior Engineer – Azure is responsible for engineering cloud automation capabilities for Azure Public Cloud. Azure Senior Engineer will be part of the Cloud Engineering team, which is responsible for building automated provisioning and platforming engineering abstraction for improved developer experience.

The Cloud Engineering team ensures public cloud services are provisioned in a timely manner to Business partners. The Cloud Engineering team also ensures the various public cloud services remain compliant to the highest of security and best practice standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Participate in designing solutions for automated provisioning and compliance of various Azure services using cloud-native capabilities and micro-services-based development.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams in the design and development of various hybrid cloud capabilities. Facilitate design and review sessions between multiple teams, including Application Engineering, Operations, Quality, and Security teams.
  • Create design documents, common patterns that facilitate the acceleration of adoption of various cloud services among application teams
  • Drive innovation through automation of services and capabilities
  • Design, deploy, and maintain complex Azure-based infrastructure and solutions, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security
  • Collaborate with multi-functional teams to gather and analyze requirements for cloud-based projects
  • Develop and maintain automation scripts and infrastructure as code templates for deploying Azure resources and cloud foundation.
  • Create Multi region Cloud foundation and automation for Azure.
  • Design and development of the Self-service Cloud capability delivery.

Required Qualifications

  • BA/BS required, preferably in a STEM field
  • 3+ years of relevant technology experience
  • 2+ years of public cloud (Azure) experience.
  • Strong expert-level skills of Azure services, including PaaS services
  • Strong hands-on coding skills in Terraform, Groovy to build an automation pipeline for deploying resources, team vending on Azure.
  • Strong background in software engineering
  • Hands-on experience in building solutions using various Azure services
  • Hands-on experience in one or more programming languages preferably Python
  • Hands-on experience developing Cloud agnostic Infrastructure As Code pipeline using Terraform
  • Strong understanding of agile development processes and Agile tool set JIRA
  • Understanding of micro-services and REST APIs-based application development
  • Understanding of GIT-based source code management, Continuous Integration, and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) practices using tools like Jenkins, Bitbucket, Artifactory, Groovy Scripting
  • Experience in developing Azure Policies.
  • Experience in deployment of multi-tenant Kubernetes platform
  • Understanding of basic Linux kernel and window server operating system
  • Experience in working with bash, PowerShell scripting.
  • Must be able to solve complex business problems and present recommendations to management effectively.
  • Must have good planning, organizational, analytical, and decision-making skills
  • With little supervision, must be able to define, shape, and drive projects to completion while effectively collaborating strategically with others
  • Strong verbal and writing skills
  • Must be results-driven, a quick learner, and a self-starter

Desired Qualifications

  • Preferred developer/associate/expert certification in Azure

Skills

Microsoft Azure, Terraform, CI/CD

title: REPRESENTANTE COMERCIAL AUTONÔMO
description:
CONTRATA-SE REPRESENTANTE COMERCIAL AUTÔNOMO – RCA


Indústria Brasileira de cosméticos atuando a 30 anos no mercado nacional, está selecionando Representante Comercial Autônomo (RCA).  –   Esta é uma excelente oportunidade para profissionais de vendas que atuam nos seguimentos: Supermercadista, Especializado em Cosméticos e Farma. Assim como os distribuidores e atacadistas desses seguimentos.


Perfil do Candidato (Requisitos)

  • Experiência Comprovada:  Vivência prévia em vendas no canal alimentar, Especializado em cosméticos e/ou farma (médio ou grande varejo. Distribuidores e atacadistas).
  • Carteira de Clientes:  Carteira ativa no segmento será um forte diferencial.
  • Documentação:  CNPJ ativo e registro no CORE (Conselho Regional dos Representantes Comerciais).
  • Ferramentas de Trabalho:  Veículo próprio e habilitação em dia.
  • Perfil comportamental:  Boa comunicação, organização, autogestão e foco em metas. 


Atribuições do Cargo

  • Visitas e Prospecção:  Realizar rota de vendas para atender clientes e leads dos seguimentos alvo;
  • Gestão de Carteira:  Visitar clientes da base e abrir novos pontos de venda.
  • Negociação:  Realizar cotações, negociações de preços e prazos.
  • Fidelização:  Manter relacionamento ativo e garantir a presença dos produtos nos pontos de vendas.
  • Ações de Trade:  Promover produtos, monitorar estoque e organizar a visibilidade dos produtos no PDV. 


Benefícios e Diferenciais (Sugestões)


  • Remuneração:  Comissionamento atrativo acima da média de mercado, baseado no volume de faturamento.
  • Incentivos:  Premiações por alcance de metas, positivação de clientes e campanhas da indústria.
  • Flexibilidade:  Liberdade de gestão da própria agenda e possibilidade de atuar com portfólios complementares (não exclusivos). 

Sobre a contratação

  • Modelo:  PJ (Pessoa Jurídica), sem vínculo empregatício CLT.

title: Senior Software Engineer UX (C# / XAML)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Software Engineer, UX, with 5+ years of professional experience to join our U.S. client. Candidates must have a strong background in C#, XAML, WinForms, and MAUI.

The ideal candidate will collaborate with a small team in an agile environment to improve our clients' UI experiences by developing new functionality and maintaining existing client applications. You must have experience with UI design, development, and debugging.

Protecting over 17,000 facilities in 80 countries across six continents, our client is a global leader in providing comprehensive visibility into critical infrastructure management, enabling swift problem resolution, waste reduction, and cost efficiencies while significantly elevating operational performance. The company's suite of software solutions enables customers to quickly identify and remediate critical plant issues, elevate plant operational performance, and ultimately drive safer, more efficient, always-on operations.


Responsibilities

  • Seek input from stakeholders, share and review UI mockups, synthesize feedback on usability, carefully consider localization, and empower other team members to create learning materials for the new UI
  • Develop view models, views, custom controls, and UI patterns in C# and XAML in both MAUI and WPF
  • Transform existing WinForms dialogs into reimagined and improved WPF implementations
  • Take ownership of solving interesting problems, architect new objects, improve the solutions of other team members, and maintain the solution as it is deployed globally


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in SaaS or enterprise environments using C# and XAML
  • Strong proficiency in WinForms and MAUI
  • Ability to contribute across the stack from back-end logic and data modeling to key front-end integrations
  • Strong understanding of component-based architecture, state management, responsive design, and performance optimization
  • Experience working collaboratively with design and back-end teams
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality code in fast-moving teams


Preferred Experience

  • Experience with third-party controls, such as Telerik and ComponentOne
  • Experience with web development, such as Angular and ASP.NET
  • Familiar with Microsoft SQL Server and Entity Framework


Additional Information:

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - Think Big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

✔ Apoiar melhorias contínuas de performance, estabilidade e acessibilidade

description:
Sobre a Empresa


Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.


Data Analyst - Sr

Required experience

Required experience Recommended experience: 5-7 years of hands-on BI application development experience

Ability to identify technical, security risks and propose mitigation actions

Hands on experience of Configuration & Release Management

Practices Participate in software modification during integration testing

Understand requirements from the stakeholders and documenting such requirements.

Transpose business requirements into data solutions.

Propose changes to improve efficiency and/or reduce operation or maintenance cost;

Create good practices and propose improvements

Gather functional and non functional, including information security requirements from the stakeholders and document such requirements.


Mandatory Skills

Advanced Data Analysis and Data Modeling skills.

Strong expertise SQL and it’s application on distributed data processing frameworks (e.g., Spark). Practical knowledge of Python development for data pipelines.

Strong expertise on developing Data Visualization apps in Power BI, including advanced DAX for complex measures’ creation, semantic models, data flows, datasets and deployment pipelines. Solid background in Git-based version control. Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines.

Experience with Azure DevOps.

Understanding of Databricks Unity Catalog, clusters, and SQL Warehouses. Comfort using CLI tools and scripting (e.g., Azure CLI, Databricks CLI).

Familiarity with app registrations and service principals.


Recommended Skills

Excellent Communication:

Ability to interact effectively with international teams, business, and IT Knowledge of the industrial, automotive, or logistics sectors.

Experience working with European teams. Experience with Azure Data Factory.

Experience with Databricks.

Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure Functions and Azure Web Apps.

Background in API integrations and JSON-based messaging.


Degree

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.


Idioma:

Imprescindível inglês fluente para atuar com equipes internacionais


CLT - obrigatório

Benefícios:

Vale Refeição - Cartão Swille

title: Mainframe Project Manager
description:
Descrição da Vaga:

Estamos em busca de um Gerente de Mainframe experiente para liderar e supervisionar projetos complexos de mainframe, garantindo execução bem-sucedida e integração fluida com os processos de negócio. O candidato ideal terá sólida experiência em tecnologias de Mainframe, incluindo z/OS, AS400, JCL, COBOL, REXX e SAS , além de forte vivência em gestão de projetos, gestão de stakeholders, avaliação de riscos e otimização de custos .

Esta função exige habilidades excepcionais de liderança para inspirar equipes, construir relacionamentos com as partes interessadas e impulsionar melhorias de processos.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver planos de projeto abrangentes, definir escopo, estabelecer cronogramas realistas e gerenciar recursos de forma eficaz.
  • Aplicar expertise em tecnologias de Mainframe Broadcom e IBM, incluindo subsistemas, JCL, COBOL e REXX.
  • Construir relacionamentos sólidos com stakeholders-chave, incluindo líderes de negócio, equipes técnicas e usuários finais.
  • Conduzir avaliações de risco, identificar riscos potenciais e desenvolver estratégias de mitigação e planos de contingência.
  • Alocar recursos de forma eficiente, acompanhar despesas e otimizar custos, garantindo o sucesso do projeto.
  • Liderar equipes de projeto, promovendo colaboração e definindo direções claras.
  • Supervisionar a execução dos projetos, assegurando aderência aos planos e cronogramas definidos.
  • Manter canais de comunicação eficazes, gerenciar expectativas dos stakeholders e tratar preocupações de forma ágil.
  • Negociar contratos, acompanhar entregáveis e garantir colaboração eficiente com fornecedores.
  • Avaliar o impacto de migrações de mainframe nos processos e fluxos de trabalho existentes, assegurando transições suaves.
  • Conduzir melhorias de processos e implementar boas práticas de gestão de mudanças.


Quais são as habilidades obrigatórias e níveis de proficiência exigidos para esta posição?

  • z/OS, AS400: Proficiência avançada em sistemas operacionais de mainframe.
  • ITIL, COBOL, JCL, SAS, REXX: Sólido conhecimento prático de linguagens, controle de jobs e scripts em mainframe.
  • Gestão de Projetos e Stakeholders: Forte capacidade de gerenciar projetos de grande escala e engajar stakeholders de forma eficaz.
  • Gestão de Riscos e Relacionamento com Fornecedores: Capacidade de avaliar e mitigar riscos, mantendo parcerias com fornecedores.
  • Orçamento e Previsão Financeira: Experiência em gestão financeira de projetos, otimização de custos e planejamento de recursos.
  • Gestão de Mudanças e Melhoria de Processos: Proficiência na implementação de estratégias de change management e melhorias contínuas.
  • Gestão de Equipes: Fortes habilidades de liderança para orientar, desenvolver e motivar equipes técnicas.


Quais são as habilidades opcionais e níveis de proficiência desejáveis para esta posição?

  • DB2, IMS, Oracle, MySQL: Experiência em gerenciamento de bancos de dados em ambientes de mainframe.

title: Senior Software Engineer UX (C# / XAML)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Software Engineer, UX, with 5+ years of professional experience to join our U.S. client. Candidates must have a strong background in C#, XAML, WinForms, and MAUI.

The ideal candidate will collaborate with a small team in an agile environment to improve our clients' UI experiences by developing new functionality and maintaining existing client applications. You must have experience with UI design, development, and debugging.

Protecting over 17,000 facilities in 80 countries across six continents, our client is a global leader in providing comprehensive visibility into critical infrastructure management, enabling swift problem resolution, waste reduction, and cost efficiencies while significantly elevating operational performance. The company's suite of software solutions enables customers to quickly identify and remediate critical plant issues, elevate plant operational performance, and ultimately drive safer, more efficient, always-on operations.


Responsibilities

  • Seek input from stakeholders, share and review UI mockups, synthesize feedback on usability, carefully consider localization, and empower other team members to create learning materials for the new UI
  • Develop view models, views, custom controls, and UI patterns in C# and XAML in both MAUI and WPF
  • Transform existing WinForms dialogs into reimagined and improved WPF implementations
  • Take ownership of solving interesting problems, architect new objects, improve the solutions of other team members, and maintain the solution as it is deployed globally


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in SaaS or enterprise environments using C# and XAML
  • Strong proficiency in WinForms and MAUI
  • Ability to contribute across the stack from back-end logic and data modeling to key front-end integrations
  • Strong understanding of component-based architecture, state management, responsive design, and performance optimization
  • Experience working collaboratively with design and back-end teams
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality code in fast-moving teams


Preferred Experience

  • Experience with third-party controls, such as Telerik and ComponentOne
  • Experience with web development, such as Angular and ASP.NET
  • Familiar with Microsoft SQL Server and Entity Framework


Additional Information:

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - Think Big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We focus on providing world-class remote resources who work as valued members of client teams. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Cloud Engineer
description:
Job Title:- Azure Cloud Engineer

Location:- Remote (Brazil)


The Senior Engineer – Azure is responsible for engineering cloud automation capabilities for Azure Public Cloud. Azure Senior Engineer will be part of the Cloud Engineering team, which is responsible for building automated provisioning and platforming engineering abstraction for improved developer experience.

title: Analista de dados
description:
Sobre a Empresa


Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.


Data Analyst - Sr

Required experience

Required experience Recommended experience: 5-7 years of hands-on BI application development experience

Ability to identify technical, security risks and propose mitigation actions

Hands on experience of Configuration & Release Management

Practices Participate in software modification during integration testing

Understand requirements from the stakeholders and documenting such requirements.

Transpose business requirements into data solutions.

Propose changes to improve efficiency and/or reduce operation or maintenance cost;

Create good practices and propose improvements

Gather functional and non functional, including information security requirements from the stakeholders and document such requirements.


Mandatory Skills

Advanced Data Analysis and Data Modeling skills.

Strong expertise SQL and it’s application on distributed data processing frameworks (e.g., Spark). Practical knowledge of Python development for data pipelines.

Strong expertise on developing Data Visualization apps in Power BI, including advanced DAX for complex measures’ creation, semantic models, data flows, datasets and deployment pipelines. Solid background in Git-based version control. Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines.

Experience with Azure DevOps.

Understanding of Databricks Unity Catalog, clusters, and SQL Warehouses. Comfort using CLI tools and scripting (e.g., Azure CLI, Databricks CLI).

Familiarity with app registrations and service principals.


Recommended Skills

Excellent Communication:

Ability to interact effectively with international teams, business, and IT Knowledge of the industrial, automotive, or logistics sectors.

Experience working with European teams. Experience with Azure Data Factory.

Experience with Databricks.

Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure Functions and Azure Web Apps.

Background in API integrations and JSON-based messaging.


Degree

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.


Idioma:

Imprescindível inglês fluente para atuar com equipes internacionais


CLT - obrigatório

Benefícios:

Vale Refeição - Cartão Swille

title: Governança em Dados
description:
Transforme o futuro com a Minsait


Na Minsai t, acreditamos na tecnologia como força para transformar realidades e gerar impacto positivo. Desenvolvemos soluções que conectam inovação, eficiência e progresso em setores essenciais como administração pública, telecomunicações & mídia, energia & utilities, indústria & consumo, saúde e finanças.

Aqui, você encontra um ambiente que valoriza a autonomia, a colaboração e o crescimento contínuo, com projetos desafiadores e oportunidades reais de desenvolvimento.


Nosso jeito de ser

  • Inovamos com propósito
  • Crescemos com responsabilidade
  • Valorizamos a diversidade e quem transforma


Valores

  • Inovação, conexão, confiança e antecipação de futuro


Se você busca desafios com significado, a Minsait é o seu lugar.


GOVERNANÇA DE DADOS


Profissional para atuar em cliente do seguimento de seguros com perfil de Governança de dados e conhecimentos analíticos em processos, normas, LGPD entre outros.


1 Conhecimento Técnico

Modelagem de Dados: Entender estruturas de dados, metadados e taxonomias.

Qualidade de Dados: Técnicas para monitorar, medir e melhorar a qualidade dos dados.

Segurança e Privacidade: LGPD, GDPR, políticas de acesso e criptografia.

Arquitetura de Dados: Compreensão de Data Lakes, Data Warehouses e integração de sistemas.


2 Normas e Compliance

Regulamentações: Conhecimento de leis e normas (LGPD, GDPR, SOX).

Políticas Internas: Definição e manutenção de padrões e processos.


3 Habilidades Analíticas

Data Stewardship: Capacidade de garantir integridade e consistência dos dados.

Análise de Impacto: Avaliar riscos e impactos de mudanças nos dados.


4 Comunicação e Liderança

Gestão de Stakeholders: Interagir com áreas de negócio e TI.

Documentação e Políticas: Criar e manter manuais, glossários e catálogos de dados.

Capacidade de Influência: Promover cultura de governança na organização.


TRABALHE NA MINSAIT


  • Modelo de contratação CLT.
  • Plano de Saúde subsidiado pela empresa para o titular.
  • Opção de inclusão de dependentes no Plano de Saúde com desconto em folha de pagamento.
  • Assistência Odontológica (opcional).
  • Vale Refeição no cartão Flash Benefícios.
  • Vale Transporte (opcional).
  • POP - Programa de Orientação Pessoal que visa oferecer suporte emocional e aconselhamento com orientação confidencial nas áreas psicológica, jurídica, financeira, social e pet sem custo para titular e dependentes legais.
  • Plataforma de Saúde Wellhub-Gympass (Acesso a mais de 700 academias em todo o Brasil com planos descontado em folha de pagamento).
  • Parcerias com grandes marcas de consumo.
  • Convênio com o SESC para titular e dependentes.
  • Convênios para descontos com instituições de ensino (graduação e pós-graduação) e escola de idiomas.
  • Seguro de vida em grupo.


Nosso compromisso com a diversidade é um elemento-chave da nossa cultura: Igualdade de oportunidades, respeito pelas pessoas e não discriminação são princípios de atuação para todos os profissionais da Minsait. Integramos o Bloomberg Gender-Equality Index (GEI) 2021 em termos de diversidade e igualdade de gênero.

title: Mainframe Project Manager
description:
Descrição da Vaga:

Estamos em busca de um Gerente de Mainframe experiente para liderar e supervisionar projetos complexos de mainframe, garantindo execução bem-sucedida e integração fluida com os processos de negócio. O candidato ideal terá sólida experiência em tecnologias de Mainframe, incluindo z/OS, AS400, JCL, COBOL, REXX e SAS , além de forte vivência em gestão de projetos, gestão de stakeholders, avaliação de riscos e otimização de custos .

Esta função exige habilidades excepcionais de liderança para inspirar equipes, construir relacionamentos com as partes interessadas e impulsionar melhorias de processos.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver planos de projeto abrangentes, definir escopo, estabelecer cronogramas realistas e gerenciar recursos de forma eficaz.
  • Aplicar expertise em tecnologias de Mainframe Broadcom e IBM, incluindo subsistemas, JCL, COBOL e REXX.
  • Construir relacionamentos sólidos com stakeholders-chave, incluindo líderes de negócio, equipes técnicas e usuários finais.
  • Conduzir avaliações de risco, identificar riscos potenciais e desenvolver estratégias de mitigação e planos de contingência.
  • Alocar recursos de forma eficiente, acompanhar despesas e otimizar custos, garantindo o sucesso do projeto.
  • Liderar equipes de projeto, promovendo colaboração e definindo direções claras.
  • Supervisionar a execução dos projetos, assegurando aderência aos planos e cronogramas definidos.
  • Manter canais de comunicação eficazes, gerenciar expectativas dos stakeholders e tratar preocupações de forma ágil.
  • Negociar contratos, acompanhar entregáveis e garantir colaboração eficiente com fornecedores.
  • Avaliar o impacto de migrações de mainframe nos processos e fluxos de trabalho existentes, assegurando transições suaves.
  • Conduzir melhorias de processos e implementar boas práticas de gestão de mudanças.


Quais são as habilidades obrigatórias e níveis de proficiência exigidos para esta posição?

  • z/OS, AS400: Proficiência avançada em sistemas operacionais de mainframe.
  • ITIL, COBOL, JCL, SAS, REXX: Sólido conhecimento prático de linguagens, controle de jobs e scripts em mainframe.
  • Gestão de Projetos e Stakeholders: Forte capacidade de gerenciar projetos de grande escala e engajar stakeholders de forma eficaz.
  • Gestão de Riscos e Relacionamento com Fornecedores: Capacidade de avaliar e mitigar riscos, mantendo parcerias com fornecedores.
  • Orçamento e Previsão Financeira: Experiência em gestão financeira de projetos, otimização de custos e planejamento de recursos.
  • Gestão de Mudanças e Melhoria de Processos: Proficiência na implementação de estratégias de change management e melhorias contínuas.
  • Gestão de Equipes: Fortes habilidades de liderança para orientar, desenvolver e motivar equipes técnicas.


Quais são as habilidades opcionais e níveis de proficiência desejáveis para esta posição?

  • DB2, IMS, Oracle, MySQL: Experiência em gerenciamento de bancos de dados em ambientes de mainframe.

title: Senior Software Engineer UX (C# / XAML)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Software Engineer, UX, with 5+ years of professional experience to join our U.S. client. Candidates must have a strong background in C#, XAML, WinForms, and MAUI.

The ideal candidate will collaborate with a small team in an agile environment to improve our clients' UI experiences by developing new functionality and maintaining existing client applications. You must have experience with UI design, development, and debugging.

Protecting over 17,000 facilities in 80 countries across six continents, our client is a global leader in providing comprehensive visibility into critical infrastructure management, enabling swift problem resolution, waste reduction, and cost efficiencies while significantly elevating operational performance. The company's suite of software solutions enables customers to quickly identify and remediate critical plant issues, elevate plant operational performance, and ultimately drive safer, more efficient, always-on operations.


Responsibilities

  • Seek input from stakeholders, share and review UI mockups, synthesize feedback on usability, carefully consider localization, and empower other team members to create learning materials for the new UI
  • Develop view models, views, custom controls, and UI patterns in C# and XAML in both MAUI and WPF
  • Transform existing WinForms dialogs into reimagined and improved WPF implementations
  • Take ownership of solving interesting problems, architect new objects, improve the solutions of other team members, and maintain the solution as it is deployed globally


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in SaaS or enterprise environments using C# and XAML
  • Strong proficiency in WinForms and MAUI
  • Ability to contribute across the stack from back-end logic and data modeling to key front-end integrations
  • Strong understanding of component-based architecture, state management, responsive design, and performance optimization
  • Experience working collaboratively with design and back-end teams
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality code in fast-moving teams


Preferred Experience

  • Experience with third-party controls, such as Telerik and ComponentOne
  • Experience with web development, such as Angular and ASP.NET
  • Familiar with Microsoft SQL Server and Entity Framework


Additional Information:

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - Think Big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We focus on providing world-class remote resources who work as valued members of client teams. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

Como empresa líder em tecnologia somos um universo de pessoas inconformadas, movidas por inovação, autonomia, aprendizado e performance.

Juntos e juntas, criamos oportunidades, transformamos futuros e compartilhamos conhecimento. Aqui o seu desenvolvimento profissional acontece em um ambiente inclusivo, respeitoso e energizante. De gente pra gente!

Buscamos o crescimento sustentável. E usamos dados e IA para impulsionar resultados mais inteligentes e eficientes para os nossos clientes.

Vem com a gente inovar e construir o futuro da tecnologia.

#VemPraTOTVS #SomosTOTVS


Missão do cargo: Garantir soluções de gestão de pessoas aderentes aos negócios para sustentar a estratégia da TOTVS, sendo referência nos temas de gestão de pessoas. Influenciar a tomada de decisão, alinhada à cultura e promover o desenvolvimento das lideranças dos clientes internos.


O que você vai fazer:


  • Atuar como canal entre gestores e suas equipes, facilitando a boa comunicação e um clima organizacional adequado para a realização de todas as atividades, através do atendimento de duas ou mais diretorias com alta complexidade em termos de headcount (volume de líderes e colaboradores TOTVS), distribuição geográfica e/ou impacto estratégico de resultados para o negócio, assim como, tamanho da operação da Unidade de sua responsabilidade;
  • Realizar diagnóstico do clima organizacional nas áreas de atuação através de pesquisas de engajamento e entrevistas de desligamento, apoiando na definição e execução dos planos de ação;
  • Conduzir junto aos gestores os processos de tomada de decisão sobre promoção, transferência, PDI´s, R&S, treinamentos e apoio no desenvolvimento de lideranças e colaboradores;
  • Atuar no desenvolvimento das lideranças internas,até nível de Diretoria, de acordo com as premissas, cultura e as práticas de líderes na TOTVS;
  • Analisar periodicamente os indicadores de gestão de pessoas da área de atendimento, através de dashboards para apoiar no estabelecimento de planos de plano de ação e influenciar as tomadas de decisões;
  • Garantir insumos de negócio para definição estratégica dos modelos de remuneração variável da área cliente, visando maior competitividade;
  • Apoiar na análise de dimensionamento da estrutura e definição de modelos de trabalho, de acordo com os desafios e estratégia do negócio;
  • Fomentar a cultura TOTVS junto das lideranças, por meio das práticas de gestão de pessoas;
  • Assegurar a aderência dos processos, políticas e ferramentas de Gestão de Pessoas e implementar nas áreas clientes. Fornecer insumos dos desafios do negócio para construções de soluções de RH customizadas junto as áreas especialistas;
  • Conduzir e acompanhar o Ciclo de Meritocracia das áreas de atendimento sob sua responsabilidade, utilizando como base as políticas e processos de recursos humanos;
  • Conduzir o processo de mapeamento sucessório da área de atendimento, por meio da indicação de colaboradores TOTVS com potencial e prontidão aos cargos mapeados e acompanhar plano de desenvolvimento de sucessores das posições chaves;
  • Participar das reuniões das áreas de atendimento para discussões estratégicas, endereçando os desafios de gestão de pessoas;
  • Analisar potenciais retenção de talentos e oxigenação dos times junto as lideranças através de insumos da avaliação de performance e aderência a cultura e conduzir o processo conforme definição;
  • Conduzir o processo de offboarding (desligamentos) das áreas de atendimento, desde a tomada de decisão, orientações a liderança e entrevista de desligamento. Estruturar e apresentar análise de attrition;
  • Atuar no desenvolvimento de novas soluções de Gestão de Pessoas, em parceria com as áreas especialistas, visando contribuir com as melhores práticas de mercado alinhadas às necessidades de negócio;
  • Participar de processo seletivo de posições chaves e gerenciais;
  • Realizar a gestão de processos operacionais para aplicação na Unidade de sua responsabilidade, assim como, a gestão de pessoas.


O que esperamos de você:


  • Graduação completa e desejável pós graduação na área de atuação;
  • Pacote office - nível avançado;
  • Domínio nos processos de Gestão de Pessoas (admissão, avaliação de performance, treinamentos e outros);
  • Conhecimento em modelos de remuneração;
  • Legislação Trabalhista - nível básico;
  • Vivência em RH e desejável experiência em gestão de pessoas e em três subsistemas de RH (Remuneração, Desenvolvimento Organizacional e outro);
  • Vivência consolidada em Consultoria Interna.


Informações adicionais:


Local de Trabalho: São Paulo/SP;

Modelo de trabalho: Híbrido.

title: Technical Support Consultant L3
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Technical Support Consultant with 3 to 5 years of software support experience to join the client operations team of our U.S. client. You will play a critical role in ensuring our client's software lives up to its world-class reputation.

Our client provides a cloud-based, ERP platform to hundreds of energy industry customers delivering market-leading field service management, field data gathering, transportation, production, accounting, and land software solutions. Backed by private equity, our client accelerates business performance, improves operational efficiency, and reduces costs.


Responsibilities

  • Deliver Level 3 customer support for our client's industry-leading software products
  • Triage reported, end-user customer incidents
  • Work technical issues and support the direct client feedback loop process
  • Help secure existing revenue by means of customer retention
  • Provide incident queue management
  • Utilize troubleshooting skills
  • Help manage complex issues and drive escalations to resolution
  • Build and demonstrate cross-application knowledge among the client's core application modules
  • Push the client's software to the limit, making sure it is efficient, intuitive, and best-in-class
  • Gain experience in the oil and gas industry; including economic, accounting, and finance knowledge


Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written skills
  • 3 to 5 years of Level 3 software support experience
  • Basic to intermediate SQL skills
  • Proficiency in using Microsoft Office Suite
  • A drive to continue learning in the energy business and the client's software
  • Advanced problem-solving skills
  • Ability to triage and actively manage a support queue
  • Innate passion for customer service
  • Dependability and ability to manage as well as prioritize concurrent tasks
  • Must be available for an on-call rotation
  • Ability to work U.S. CST business hours
  • Must be a self-starter and resourceful
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team
  • Proven experience working effectively in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
  • Experience creating manuals, training documentation, and interactive training materials for software applications
  • Experience providing software support and troubleshooting for SaaS applications
  • Experience in reproducing issues in a test environment prior to production deployment
  • Experience in the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)
  • Experience with oil and gas revenue accounting, gas processing, crude/gas/NGL transportation, or related fields


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Mainframe Project Manager
description:
Descrição da Vaga:

Estamos em busca de um Gerente de Mainframe experiente para liderar e supervisionar projetos complexos de mainframe, garantindo execução bem-sucedida e integração fluida com os processos de negócio. O candidato ideal terá sólida experiência em tecnologias de Mainframe, incluindo z/OS, AS400, JCL, COBOL, REXX e SAS , além de forte vivência em gestão de projetos, gestão de stakeholders, avaliação de riscos e otimização de custos .

Esta função exige habilidades excepcionais de liderança para inspirar equipes, construir relacionamentos com as partes interessadas e impulsionar melhorias de processos.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver planos de projeto abrangentes, definir escopo, estabelecer cronogramas realistas e gerenciar recursos de forma eficaz.
  • Aplicar expertise em tecnologias de Mainframe Broadcom e IBM, incluindo subsistemas, JCL, COBOL e REXX.
  • Construir relacionamentos sólidos com stakeholders-chave, incluindo líderes de negócio, equipes técnicas e usuários finais.
  • Conduzir avaliações de risco, identificar riscos potenciais e desenvolver estratégias de mitigação e planos de contingência.
  • Alocar recursos de forma eficiente, acompanhar despesas e otimizar custos, garantindo o sucesso do projeto.
  • Liderar equipes de projeto, promovendo colaboração e definindo direções claras.
  • Supervisionar a execução dos projetos, assegurando aderência aos planos e cronogramas definidos.
  • Manter canais de comunicação eficazes, gerenciar expectativas dos stakeholders e tratar preocupações de forma ágil.
  • Negociar contratos, acompanhar entregáveis e garantir colaboração eficiente com fornecedores.
  • Avaliar o impacto de migrações de mainframe nos processos e fluxos de trabalho existentes, assegurando transições suaves.
  • Conduzir melhorias de processos e implementar boas práticas de gestão de mudanças.


Quais são as habilidades obrigatórias e níveis de proficiência exigidos para esta posição?

  • z/OS, AS400: Proficiência avançada em sistemas operacionais de mainframe.
  • ITIL, COBOL, JCL, SAS, REXX: Sólido conhecimento prático de linguagens, controle de jobs e scripts em mainframe.
  • Gestão de Projetos e Stakeholders: Forte capacidade de gerenciar projetos de grande escala e engajar stakeholders de forma eficaz.
  • Gestão de Riscos e Relacionamento com Fornecedores: Capacidade de avaliar e mitigar riscos, mantendo parcerias com fornecedores.
  • Orçamento e Previsão Financeira: Experiência em gestão financeira de projetos, otimização de custos e planejamento de recursos.
  • Gestão de Mudanças e Melhoria de Processos: Proficiência na implementação de estratégias de change management e melhorias contínuas.
  • Gestão de Equipes: Fortes habilidades de liderança para orientar, desenvolver e motivar equipes técnicas.


Quais são as habilidades opcionais e níveis de proficiência desejáveis para esta posição?

  • DB2, IMS, Oracle, MySQL: Experiência em gerenciamento de bancos de dados em ambientes de mainframe.

title: Senior Software Engineer UX (C# / XAML)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Software Engineer, UX, with 5+ years of professional experience to join our U.S. client. Candidates must have a strong background in C#, XAML, WinForms, and MAUI.

The ideal candidate will collaborate with a small team in an agile environment to improve our clients' UI experiences by developing new functionality and maintaining existing client applications. You must have experience with UI design, development, and debugging.

Protecting over 17,000 facilities in 80 countries across six continents, our client is a global leader in providing comprehensive visibility into critical infrastructure management, enabling swift problem resolution, waste reduction, and cost efficiencies while significantly elevating operational performance. The company's suite of software solutions enables customers to quickly identify and remediate critical plant issues, elevate plant operational performance, and ultimately drive safer, more efficient, always-on operations.


Responsibilities

  • Seek input from stakeholders, share and review UI mockups, synthesize feedback on usability, carefully consider localization, and empower other team members to create learning materials for the new UI
  • Develop view models, views, custom controls, and UI patterns in C# and XAML in both MAUI and WPF
  • Transform existing WinForms dialogs into reimagined and improved WPF implementations
  • Take ownership of solving interesting problems, architect new objects, improve the solutions of other team members, and maintain the solution as it is deployed globally


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in SaaS or enterprise environments using C# and XAML
  • Strong proficiency in WinForms and MAUI
  • Ability to contribute across the stack from back-end logic and data modeling to key front-end integrations
  • Strong understanding of component-based architecture, state management, responsive design, and performance optimization
  • Experience working collaboratively with design and back-end teams
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality code in fast-moving teams


Preferred Experience

  • Experience with third-party controls, such as Telerik and ComponentOne
  • Experience with web development, such as Angular and ASP.NET
  • Familiar with Microsoft SQL Server and Entity Framework


Additional Information:

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - Think Big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!

title: Analista de dados
description:
Sobre a Empresa


Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.


Data Analyst - Sr

Required experience

Required experience Recommended experience: 5-7 years of hands-on BI application development experience

Ability to identify technical, security risks and propose mitigation actions

Hands on experience of Configuration & Release Management

Practices Participate in software modification during integration testing

Understand requirements from the stakeholders and documenting such requirements.

Transpose business requirements into data solutions.

Propose changes to improve efficiency and/or reduce operation or maintenance cost;

Create good practices and propose improvements

Gather functional and non functional, including information security requirements from the stakeholders and document such requirements.


Mandatory Skills

Advanced Data Analysis and Data Modeling skills.

Strong expertise SQL and it’s application on distributed data processing frameworks (e.g., Spark). Practical knowledge of Python development for data pipelines.

Strong expertise on developing Data Visualization apps in Power BI, including advanced DAX for complex measures’ creation, semantic models, data flows, datasets and deployment pipelines. Solid background in Git-based version control. Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines.

Experience with Azure DevOps.

Understanding of Databricks Unity Catalog, clusters, and SQL Warehouses. Comfort using CLI tools and scripting (e.g., Azure CLI, Databricks CLI).

Familiarity with app registrations and service principals.


Recommended Skills

Excellent Communication:

Ability to interact effectively with international teams, business, and IT Knowledge of the industrial, automotive, or logistics sectors.

Experience working with European teams. Experience with Azure Data Factory.

Experience with Databricks.

Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure Functions and Azure Web Apps.

Background in API integrations and JSON-based messaging.


Degree

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.


Idioma:

Imprescindível inglês fluente para atuar com equipes internacionais


CLT - obrigatório

Benefícios:

Vale Refeição - Cartão Swille

title: Mainframe Project Manager
description:
Descrição da Vaga:

Estamos em busca de um Gerente de Mainframe experiente para liderar e supervisionar projetos complexos de mainframe, garantindo execução bem-sucedida e integração fluida com os processos de negócio. O candidato ideal terá sólida experiência em tecnologias de Mainframe, incluindo z/OS, AS400, JCL, COBOL, REXX e SAS , além de forte vivência em gestão de projetos, gestão de stakeholders, avaliação de riscos e otimização de custos .

Esta função exige habilidades excepcionais de liderança para inspirar equipes, construir relacionamentos com as partes interessadas e impulsionar melhorias de processos.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver planos de projeto abrangentes, definir escopo, estabelecer cronogramas realistas e gerenciar recursos de forma eficaz.
  • Aplicar expertise em tecnologias de Mainframe Broadcom e IBM, incluindo subsistemas, JCL, COBOL e REXX.
  • Construir relacionamentos sólidos com stakeholders-chave, incluindo líderes de negócio, equipes técnicas e usuários finais.
  • Conduzir avaliações de risco, identificar riscos potenciais e desenvolver estratégias de mitigação e planos de contingência.
  • Alocar recursos de forma eficiente, acompanhar despesas e otimizar custos, garantindo o sucesso do projeto.
  • Liderar equipes de projeto, promovendo colaboração e definindo direções claras.
  • Supervisionar a execução dos projetos, assegurando aderência aos planos e cronogramas definidos.
  • Manter canais de comunicação eficazes, gerenciar expectativas dos stakeholders e tratar preocupações de forma ágil.
  • Negociar contratos, acompanhar entregáveis e garantir colaboração eficiente com fornecedores.
  • Avaliar o impacto de migrações de mainframe nos processos e fluxos de trabalho existentes, assegurando transições suaves.
  • Conduzir melhorias de processos e implementar boas práticas de gestão de mudanças.


Quais são as habilidades obrigatórias e níveis de proficiência exigidos para esta posição?

  • z/OS, AS400: Proficiência avançada em sistemas operacionais de mainframe.
  • ITIL, COBOL, JCL, SAS, REXX: Sólido conhecimento prático de linguagens, controle de jobs e scripts em mainframe.
  • Gestão de Projetos e Stakeholders: Forte capacidade de gerenciar projetos de grande escala e engajar stakeholders de forma eficaz.
  • Gestão de Riscos e Relacionamento com Fornecedores: Capacidade de avaliar e mitigar riscos, mantendo parcerias com fornecedores.
  • Orçamento e Previsão Financeira: Experiência em gestão financeira de projetos, otimização de custos e planejamento de recursos.
  • Gestão de Mudanças e Melhoria de Processos: Proficiência na implementação de estratégias de change management e melhorias contínuas.
  • Gestão de Equipes: Fortes habilidades de liderança para orientar, desenvolver e motivar equipes técnicas.


Quais são as habilidades opcionais e níveis de proficiência desejáveis para esta posição?

  • DB2, IMS, Oracle, MySQL: Experiência em gerenciamento de bancos de dados em ambientes de mainframe.

title: Senior Software Engineer UX (C# / XAML)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Software Engineer, UX, with 5+ years of professional experience to join our U.S. client. Candidates must have a strong background in C#, XAML, WinForms, and MAUI.

The ideal candidate will collaborate with a small team in an agile environment to improve our clients' UI experiences by developing new functionality and maintaining existing client applications. You must have experience with UI design, development, and debugging.

Protecting over 17,000 facilities in 80 countries across six continents, our client is a global leader in providing comprehensive visibility into critical infrastructure management, enabling swift problem resolution, waste reduction, and cost efficiencies while significantly elevating operational performance. The company's suite of software solutions enables customers to quickly identify and remediate critical plant issues, elevate plant operational performance, and ultimately drive safer, more efficient, always-on operations.


Responsibilities

  • Seek input from stakeholders, share and review UI mockups, synthesize feedback on usability, carefully consider localization, and empower other team members to create learning materials for the new UI
  • Develop view models, views, custom controls, and UI patterns in C# and XAML in both MAUI and WPF
  • Transform existing WinForms dialogs into reimagined and improved WPF implementations
  • Take ownership of solving interesting problems, architect new objects, improve the solutions of other team members, and maintain the solution as it is deployed globally


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in SaaS or enterprise environments using C# and XAML
  • Strong proficiency in WinForms and MAUI
  • Ability to contribute across the stack from back-end logic and data modeling to key front-end integrations
  • Strong understanding of component-based architecture, state management, responsive design, and performance optimization
  • Experience working collaboratively with design and back-end teams
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality code in fast-moving teams


Preferred Experience

  • Experience with third-party controls, such as Telerik and ComponentOne
  • Experience with web development, such as Angular and ASP.NET
  • Familiar with Microsoft SQL Server and Entity Framework


Additional Information:

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - Think Big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We focus on providing world-class remote resources who work as valued members of client teams. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Assistente de Visual Merchandising - Shopping Metrô Tucuruvi
description:
Que tal entrar para o nosso #TimedeCampeões ?

Aqui é lugar de gente que tem sede de vitória, é apaixonado por esporte, acredita no trabalho em equipe e está disposto a correr junto com os nossos clientes.


Aqui é lugar de gente que tem sede de vitória!


Apaixonado por moda e esportes? Então esta é sua chance! Aqui, você vai deixar nossas lojas sempre estilosas e irresistíveis, garantindo que cada vitrine e ambiente mostre as últimas tendências.


Para entrar em campo nesta posição, você precisa:


  • Manter a loja sempre atrativa, com ambientes e vitrines que reforcem a nossa paixão pelo esporte, por meio das tendências de moda.
  • Garantir a identidade da nossa marca na loja.
  • Oferecer suporte e apoio aos nossos clientes e ao time.


Pra jogar bonito você precisa ter:


  • Ensino Médio completo
  • Conhecimento em moda, relacionado a tendências, identidade visual e estratégias de marketing
  • Boa comunicação e facilidade no aprendizado


SOBRE A CENTAURO


A Centauro é a maior empresa de artigos esportivos da América Latina. Nossa maior missão é mobilizar pessoas e transformar vidas por meio do esporte, por isso, nos orgulhamos da nossa trajetória, que iniciou em 1981 e resultou em nossas mais de 220 lojas, presentes em todas as regiões do Brasil.


Por aqui, cada jogada é ensaiada e nossos craques contam com técnicos, líderes de lojas e todas as ferramentas necessárias para uma visão estratégica de jogo!


O clima em loja é de descontração, mas quando chega a hora da partida, cada craque veste a camisa da sua posição e joga junto dos clientes. E se você precisar de ajuda, saiba que nosso time #jogaentrosado , afinal, aqui #miramosotopo.

Muito mais que uma loja, a Centauro é um lugar de histórias escritas por vencedores. Vem fazer seu nome, vem fazer parte do nosso #TimeDeCampeões!

title: Cloud Engineer
description:
Job Title:- Azure Cloud Engineer

Location:- Remote (Brazil)


The Senior Engineer – Azure is responsible for engineering cloud automation capabilities for Azure Public Cloud. Azure Senior Engineer will be part of the Cloud Engineering team, which is responsible for building automated provisioning and platforming engineering abstraction for improved developer experience.

The Cloud Engineering team ensures public cloud services are provisioned in a timely manner to Business partners. The Cloud Engineering team also ensures the various public cloud services remain compliant to the highest of security and best practice standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Participate in designing solutions for automated provisioning and compliance of various Azure services using cloud-native capabilities and micro-services-based development.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams in the design and development of various hybrid cloud capabilities. Facilitate design and review sessions between multiple teams, including Application Engineering, Operations, Quality, and Security teams.
  • Create design documents, common patterns that facilitate the acceleration of adoption of various cloud services among application teams
  • Drive innovation through automation of services and capabilities
  • Design, deploy, and maintain complex Azure-based infrastructure and solutions, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security
  • Collaborate with multi-functional teams to gather and analyze requirements for cloud-based projects
  • Develop and maintain automation scripts and infrastructure as code templates for deploying Azure resources and cloud foundation.
  • Create Multi region Cloud foundation and automation for Azure.
  • Design and development of the Self-service Cloud capability delivery.

Required Qualifications

  • BA/BS required, preferably in a STEM field
  • 3+ years of relevant technology experience
  • 2+ years of public cloud (Azure) experience.
  • Strong expert-level skills of Azure services, including PaaS services
  • Strong hands-on coding skills in Terraform, Groovy to build an automation pipeline for deploying resources, team vending on Azure.
  • Strong background in software engineering
  • Hands-on experience in building solutions using various Azure services
  • Hands-on experience in one or more programming languages preferably Python
  • Hands-on experience developing Cloud agnostic Infrastructure As Code pipeline using Terraform
  • Strong understanding of agile development processes and Agile tool set JIRA
  • Understanding of micro-services and REST APIs-based application development
  • Understanding of GIT-based source code management, Continuous Integration, and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) practices using tools like Jenkins, Bitbucket, Artifactory, Groovy Scripting
  • Experience in developing Azure Policies.
  • Experience in deployment of multi-tenant Kubernetes platform
  • Understanding of basic Linux kernel and window server operating system
  • Experience in working with bash, PowerShell scripting.
  • Must be able to solve complex business problems and present recommendations to management effectively.
  • Must have good planning, organizational, analytical, and decision-making skills
  • With little supervision, must be able to define, shape, and drive projects to completion while effectively collaborating strategically with others
  • Strong verbal and writing skills
  • Must be results-driven, a quick learner, and a self-starter

Desired Qualifications

  • Preferred developer/associate/expert certification in Azure

Skills

Microsoft Azure, Terraform, CI/CD

title: Technical Support Consultant L3
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Technical Support Consultant with 3 to 5 years of software support experience to join the client operations team of our U.S. client. You will play a critical role in ensuring our client's software lives up to its world-class reputation.

Our client provides a cloud-based, ERP platform to hundreds of energy industry customers delivering market-leading field service management, field data gathering, transportation, production, accounting, and land software solutions. Backed by private equity, our client accelerates business performance, improves operational efficiency, and reduces costs.


Responsibilities

  • Deliver Level 3 customer support for our client's industry-leading software products
  • Triage reported, end-user customer incidents
  • Work technical issues and support the direct client feedback loop process
  • Help secure existing revenue by means of customer retention
  • Provide incident queue management
  • Utilize troubleshooting skills
  • Help manage complex issues and drive escalations to resolution
  • Build and demonstrate cross-application knowledge among the client's core application modules
  • Push the client's software to the limit, making sure it is efficient, intuitive, and best-in-class
  • Gain experience in the oil and gas industry; including economic, accounting, and finance knowledge


Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written skills
  • 3 to 5 years of Level 3 software support experience
  • Basic to intermediate SQL skills
  • Proficiency in using Microsoft Office Suite
  • A drive to continue learning in the energy business and the client's software
  • Advanced problem-solving skills
  • Ability to triage and actively manage a support queue
  • Innate passion for customer service
  • Dependability and ability to manage as well as prioritize concurrent tasks
  • Must be available for an on-call rotation
  • Ability to work U.S. CST business hours
  • Must be a self-starter and resourceful
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team
  • Proven experience working effectively in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
  • Experience creating manuals, training documentation, and interactive training materials for software applications
  • Experience providing software support and troubleshooting for SaaS applications
  • Experience in reproducing issues in a test environment prior to production deployment
  • Experience in the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)
  • Experience with oil and gas revenue accounting, gas processing, crude/gas/NGL transportation, or related fields


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


  • O que você deve ter?


Buscamos um(a) profissional para atuar no desenvolvimento, monitoramento e sustentação dos processos da squad , participando ativamente da evolução técnica das aplicações e garantindo qualidade, performance e escalabilidade.

Principais responsabilidades

✔ Desenvolver, monitorar e sustentar aplicações da squad

✔ Atuar em ambientes cloud AWS , com foco em arquitetura e boas práticas

✔ Trabalhar com integrações backend e frontend

✔ Apoiar melhorias contínuas de performance, estabilidade e acessibilidade

✔ Atuar de forma colaborativa com o time técnico

title: Mainframe Project Manager
description:
Descrição da Vaga:

Estamos em busca de um Gerente de Mainframe experiente para liderar e supervisionar projetos complexos de mainframe, garantindo execução bem-sucedida e integração fluida com os processos de negócio. O candidato ideal terá sólida experiência em tecnologias de Mainframe, incluindo z/OS, AS400, JCL, COBOL, REXX e SAS , além de forte vivência em gestão de projetos, gestão de stakeholders, avaliação de riscos e otimização de custos .

Esta função exige habilidades excepcionais de liderança para inspirar equipes, construir relacionamentos com as partes interessadas e impulsionar melhorias de processos.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver planos de projeto abrangentes, definir escopo, estabelecer cronogramas realistas e gerenciar recursos de forma eficaz.
  • Aplicar expertise em tecnologias de Mainframe Broadcom e IBM, incluindo subsistemas, JCL, COBOL e REXX.
  • Construir relacionamentos sólidos com stakeholders-chave, incluindo líderes de negócio, equipes técnicas e usuários finais.
  • Conduzir avaliações de risco, identificar riscos potenciais e desenvolver estratégias de mitigação e planos de contingência.
  • Alocar recursos de forma eficiente, acompanhar despesas e otimizar custos, garantindo o sucesso do projeto.
  • Liderar equipes de projeto, promovendo colaboração e definindo direções claras.
  • Supervisionar a execução dos projetos, assegurando aderência aos planos e cronogramas definidos.
  • Manter canais de comunicação eficazes, gerenciar expectativas dos stakeholders e tratar preocupações de forma ágil.
  • Negociar contratos, acompanhar entregáveis e garantir colaboração eficiente com fornecedores.
  • Avaliar o impacto de migrações de mainframe nos processos e fluxos de trabalho existentes, assegurando transições suaves.
  • Conduzir melhorias de processos e implementar boas práticas de gestão de mudanças.


Quais são as habilidades obrigatórias e níveis de proficiência exigidos para esta posição?

  • z/OS, AS400: Proficiência avançada em sistemas operacionais de mainframe.
  • ITIL, COBOL, JCL, SAS, REXX: Sólido conhecimento prático de linguagens, controle de jobs e scripts em mainframe.
  • Gestão de Projetos e Stakeholders: Forte capacidade de gerenciar projetos de grande escala e engajar stakeholders de forma eficaz.
  • Gestão de Riscos e Relacionamento com Fornecedores: Capacidade de avaliar e mitigar riscos, mantendo parcerias com fornecedores.
  • Orçamento e Previsão Financeira: Experiência em gestão financeira de projetos, otimização de custos e planejamento de recursos.
  • Gestão de Mudanças e Melhoria de Processos: Proficiência na implementação de estratégias de change management e melhorias contínuas.
  • Gestão de Equipes: Fortes habilidades de liderança para orientar, desenvolver e motivar equipes técnicas.


Quais são as habilidades opcionais e níveis de proficiência desejáveis para esta posição?

  • DB2, IMS, Oracle, MySQL: Experiência em gerenciamento de bancos de dados em ambientes de mainframe.

title: DevOps Engineer (Relocation to Portugal)
description:
A Job? Or a Lifetime Experience? Start Yours Here!


**Please note that we're aiming at an expatriation to Portugal**


We are a Portuguese technology consulting company with a strong outward look to the rest of Europe. We have 12 years of experience in the market and reached the status of “large company” in 2018. We now have more than 350 associates and we keep growing, with offices in Lisbon, Porto, and Leiria , as well as projects in more than 20 countries. Our company is part of the national top 10, with a growth of 250% in the last years.


Work-life balance is part of our DNA. We focus on win-win-win relationships, defining every moment of interaction as an experience with unique conditions. Working with Affinity is a “Lifetime Experience ” where you will have the opportunity to demonstrate all your potential and to be successful on every level.


#welcometoyourfuture


What you'll need to have

  • Proven experience with Azure Databricks or Azure Data Factory.
  • Advanced knowledge of Kubernetes and hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure.
  • Experience in creating and maintaining Helm Charts.
  • Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools like Terraform or CloudFormation.
  • Experience with CI/CD (e.g., GitLab CI, Jenkins, ArgoCD).
  • Scripting knowledge in Bash, Python, or equivalent.
  • Experience in monitoring and troubleshooting distributed systems.
  • English proficiency (minimum B2 level).
  • Availability to relocate and live in Portugal with our support;


Also good to have:

  • Experience with Service Mesh (e.g., Istio, Linkerd).
  • Knowledge of Kubernetes and cloud security.
  • Familiarity with full-stack observability.
  • Kubernetes certifications (CKA, CKAD) are valued.


What we expect from you

  • Will to exceed expectations (your own and the ones defined by Affinity);
  • Exceptional skills and the will to acquire more;
  • Good people skills (not just in terms of technology, language, and platforms), team spirit, and pleasant disposition;
  • Autonomy, proactivity, and focus (even under pressure);
  • Obsession for doing things right, and ability to prioritize;
  • Versatility (you can be a fan of BYOD or not);
  • Ability to innovate and evolve in a market in constant mutation.


What will encourage you

  • Being part of a company that has a disruptive action in the technology market;
  • Being part of a technology focused on relationships, simplicity, and efficiency;
  • Accessing a generative career directly proportional to your performance and interest;
  • The real possibility of being part of our company staff.


Do you think you're the one we are looking for?

title: Senior Software Engineer UX (C# / XAML)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Software Engineer, UX, with 5+ years of professional experience to join our U.S. client. Candidates must have a strong background in C#, XAML, WinForms, and MAUI.

The ideal candidate will collaborate with a small team in an agile environment to improve our clients' UI experiences by developing new functionality and maintaining existing client applications. You must have experience with UI design, development, and debugging.

Protecting over 17,000 facilities in 80 countries across six continents, our client is a global leader in providing comprehensive visibility into critical infrastructure management, enabling swift problem resolution, waste reduction, and cost efficiencies while significantly elevating operational performance. The company's suite of software solutions enables customers to quickly identify and remediate critical plant issues, elevate plant operational performance, and ultimately drive safer, more efficient, always-on operations.


Responsibilities

  • Seek input from stakeholders, share and review UI mockups, synthesize feedback on usability, carefully consider localization, and empower other team members to create learning materials for the new UI
  • Develop view models, views, custom controls, and UI patterns in C# and XAML in both MAUI and WPF
  • Transform existing WinForms dialogs into reimagined and improved WPF implementations
  • Take ownership of solving interesting problems, architect new objects, improve the solutions of other team members, and maintain the solution as it is deployed globally


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in SaaS or enterprise environments using C# and XAML
  • Strong proficiency in WinForms and MAUI
  • Ability to contribute across the stack from back-end logic and data modeling to key front-end integrations
  • Strong understanding of component-based architecture, state management, responsive design, and performance optimization
  • Experience working collaboratively with design and back-end teams
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality code in fast-moving teams


Preferred Experience

  • Experience with third-party controls, such as Telerik and ComponentOne
  • Experience with web development, such as Angular and ASP.NET
  • Familiar with Microsoft SQL Server and Entity Framework


Additional Information:

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - Think Big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We focus on providing world-class remote resources who work as valued members of client teams. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Cloud Engineer
description:
Job Title:- Azure Cloud Engineer

Location:- Remote (Brazil)


The Senior Engineer – Azure is responsible for engineering cloud automation capabilities for Azure Public Cloud. Azure Senior Engineer will be part of the Cloud Engineering team, which is responsible for building automated provisioning and platforming engineering abstraction for improved developer experience.

The Cloud Engineering team ensures public cloud services are provisioned in a timely manner to Business partners. The Cloud Engineering team also ensures the various public cloud services remain compliant to the highest of security and best practice standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Participate in designing solutions for automated provisioning and compliance of various Azure services using cloud-native capabilities and micro-services-based development.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams in the design and development of various hybrid cloud capabilities. Facilitate design and review sessions between multiple teams, including Application Engineering, Operations, Quality, and Security teams.
  • Create design documents, common patterns that facilitate the acceleration of adoption of various cloud services among application teams
  • Drive innovation through automation of services and capabilities
  • Design, deploy, and maintain complex Azure-based infrastructure and solutions, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security
  • Collaborate with multi-functional teams to gather and analyze requirements for cloud-based projects
  • Develop and maintain automation scripts and infrastructure as code templates for deploying Azure resources and cloud foundation.
  • Create Multi region Cloud foundation and automation for Azure.
  • Design and development of the Self-service Cloud capability delivery.

Required Qualifications

  • BA/BS required, preferably in a STEM field
  • 3+ years of relevant technology experience
  • 2+ years of public cloud (Azure) experience.
  • Strong expert-level skills of Azure services, including PaaS services
  • Strong hands-on coding skills in Terraform, Groovy to build an automation pipeline for deploying resources, team vending on Azure.
  • Strong background in software engineering
  • Hands-on experience in building solutions using various Azure services
  • Hands-on experience in one or more programming languages preferably Python
  • Hands-on experience developing Cloud agnostic Infrastructure As Code pipeline using Terraform
  • Strong understanding of agile development processes and Agile tool set JIRA
  • Understanding of micro-services and REST APIs-based application development
  • Understanding of GIT-based source code management, Continuous Integration, and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) practices using tools like Jenkins, Bitbucket, Artifactory, Groovy Scripting
  • Experience in developing Azure Policies.
  • Experience in deployment of multi-tenant Kubernetes platform
  • Understanding of basic Linux kernel and window server operating system
  • Experience in working with bash, PowerShell scripting.
  • Must be able to solve complex business problems and present recommendations to management effectively.
  • Must have good planning, organizational, analytical, and decision-making skills
  • With little supervision, must be able to define, shape, and drive projects to completion while effectively collaborating strategically with others
  • Strong verbal and writing skills
  • Must be results-driven, a quick learner, and a self-starter

Desired Qualifications

  • Preferred developer/associate/expert certification in Azure

Skills

Microsoft Azure, Terraform, CI/CD

title: Mainframe Project Manager
description:
Descrição da Vaga:

Estamos em busca de um Gerente de Mainframe experiente para liderar e supervisionar projetos complexos de mainframe, garantindo execução bem-sucedida e integração fluida com os processos de negócio. O candidato ideal terá sólida experiência em tecnologias de Mainframe, incluindo z/OS, AS400, JCL, COBOL, REXX e SAS , além de forte vivência em gestão de projetos, gestão de stakeholders, avaliação de riscos e otimização de custos .

Esta função exige habilidades excepcionais de liderança para inspirar equipes, construir relacionamentos com as partes interessadas e impulsionar melhorias de processos.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver planos de projeto abrangentes, definir escopo, estabelecer cronogramas realistas e gerenciar recursos de forma eficaz.
  • Aplicar expertise em tecnologias de Mainframe Broadcom e IBM, incluindo subsistemas, JCL, COBOL e REXX.
  • Construir relacionamentos sólidos com stakeholders-chave, incluindo líderes de negócio, equipes técnicas e usuários finais.
  • Conduzir avaliações de risco, identificar riscos potenciais e desenvolver estratégias de mitigação e planos de contingência.
  • Alocar recursos de forma eficiente, acompanhar despesas e otimizar custos, garantindo o sucesso do projeto.
  • Liderar equipes de projeto, promovendo colaboração e definindo direções claras.
  • Supervisionar a execução dos projetos, assegurando aderência aos planos e cronogramas definidos.
  • Manter canais de comunicação eficazes, gerenciar expectativas dos stakeholders e tratar preocupações de forma ágil.
  • Negociar contratos, acompanhar entregáveis e garantir colaboração eficiente com fornecedores.
  • Avaliar o impacto de migrações de mainframe nos processos e fluxos de trabalho existentes, assegurando transições suaves.
  • Conduzir melhorias de processos e implementar boas práticas de gestão de mudanças.


Quais são as habilidades obrigatórias e níveis de proficiência exigidos para esta posição?

  • z/OS, AS400: Proficiência avançada em sistemas operacionais de mainframe.
  • ITIL, COBOL, JCL, SAS, REXX: Sólido conhecimento prático de linguagens, controle de jobs e scripts em mainframe.
  • Gestão de Projetos e Stakeholders: Forte capacidade de gerenciar projetos de grande escala e engajar stakeholders de forma eficaz.
  • Gestão de Riscos e Relacionamento com Fornecedores: Capacidade de avaliar e mitigar riscos, mantendo parcerias com fornecedores.
  • Orçamento e Previsão Financeira: Experiência em gestão financeira de projetos, otimização de custos e planejamento de recursos.
  • Gestão de Mudanças e Melhoria de Processos: Proficiência na implementação de estratégias de change management e melhorias contínuas.
  • Gestão de Equipes: Fortes habilidades de liderança para orientar, desenvolver e motivar equipes técnicas.


Quais são as habilidades opcionais e níveis de proficiência desejáveis para esta posição?

  • DB2, IMS, Oracle, MySQL: Experiência em gerenciamento de bancos de dados em ambientes de mainframe.
